**Tesla Model S – India (approximate)**  

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Base price (USD)** | ~ $90 000–$95 000 (depending on trim & options) |
| **Estimated INR (at 1 USD ≈ 82 INR)** | **₹7.4 – 7.8 million** |
| **Taxes & duties** | Import duty (≈ 30 % on the vehicle’s value), GST (18 % on the post‑duty value), registration & road tax (varies by state). These can add roughly **₹2–3 million** to the final price. |
| **Total estimated cost** | **₹9.6 – 11 million** (₹9.6 million for a base model, ₹11 million for a fully‑loaded variant). |

> **Note:**  
> • Tesla has **not yet launched** a dedicated Model S in India, so the above figures are *estimated* based on the U.S. price and typical import‑tax structure.  
> • Actual prices will depend on the final configuration, local taxes, and any changes in duty rates.  
> • If you’re interested in buying a Model S in India, you’ll likely need to import it through a third‑party dealer or a private importer, which can add additional logistics and compliance costs.

If you’d like a more precise quote once Tesla officially enters the Indian market, let me know and I can help you track the latest pricing and availability.
